title: “Africa is also driving innovation,” says Tendresse Lompala, MMB Packaging
summary: Tendresse Lompala is a Congolese entrepreneur based in Kinshasa, Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC). Trained as a nurse and nutritionist, she is the founder and Managing Director of MMB Packaging (Mwana Mboka Tolia ya Biso), a company specialising in the design, manufacturing and customisation of packaging for food and cosmetic products. title: Coty continues transformation as quarterly profit jumps 64%
summary: The American cosmetics and fragrance group Coty (Marc Jacobs, Burberry fragrances, Calvin Klein, etc.) reported a 64% increase in profit for the July–September period, supported by demand in its key markets and proceeds from the sale of one of its licenses. Currently undergoing a transformation, the group posted a profit of USD 106 million in the first quarter of its 2026/2027 fiscal year, compared with USD 65 million a year earlier, according to a press release issued on Wednesday,... - Industry buzz

title: David Konckier, owner of Bogart Group, completes acquisition of Marionnaud
summary: David Konckier, the main shareholder of the Bogart Group, has finalized the acquisition of the Marionnaud Group through his company BEHN. The transaction, undertaken in a personal capacity, was initially announced in a press release on July 6. The selective perfumery retailer thus comes under the control of the businessman, following more than 20 years under the ownership of Hong Kong-based conglomerate CK Hutchison, which also owns the AS Watson retail group. title: Seppic strengthens its natural cosmetics business with Minasolve acquisition
summary: Minasolve, a pioneer in green chemistry specializing in natural preservation boosters for cosmetic products, particularly 100% bio-based glycols, is joining Seppic, a subsidiary of the Air Liquide Group. Founded in 2007 and a subsidiary of the Minafin Group, Minasolve specializes in upcycling agricultural residues (such as sugarcane bagasse) and transforming them into high-performance cosmetic ingredients. title: BASF develops sustainable supply chains for cosmetic bioactives in the Amazon
summary: Derived from the andiroba tree, also known as crabwood, the emollient Cetiol Forest CG is the first product launched under the Standing Forest programme, which seeks to support local communities while helping protect the rainforest.
